note: The shape is the type and the codec at once; TypeScript needs no separate serializer or given
A TypeScript tool's parameters are one record shape with no per-field descriptions, so the tool's description says what they are; a tool with no parameters takes an empty record
The TypeScript SDK provides no ready-made guardrails (no maxInputLength or forbidding); the region declares the length check itself and names it in the plan

exclude: A TypeScript agent's memory is the whole session or none: `memory(false)` for a one-shot interaction; there is no window, read-only, write-only or filtered provider, which are the JVM runtime's

note: There is no AgentRuntime in a TypeScript service: agents are registered as any component is, and the model is the sidecar's, configured through the descriptor's environment

exclude: A process names a configured provider, not a model: the provider classes are the JVM runtime's, and a TypeScript service configures its providers on the sidecar through the descriptor's environment
A process names a configured provider, not a model: a TypeScript service's providers are configured on the sidecar (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANKKA_MODEL_<NAME>_*), not built in code
A process names a configured provider, not a model: a provider's defaults are the sidecar's configuration, not a value a TypeScript handler builds
Compaction is not yet configurable for a Python or TypeScript service's sessions
